grammar.summary: 本课学习表纯幻想的虚拟语气（初步感知）。

points.title: as if 表虚拟（初步）
points.explanation: He talked as if he were a hero. as if + were = 虚拟语气初步感知：与事实相反用 were（不分人称）。

examples.en: He acted as if nothing had happened.
examples.cn: 他表现得像什么都没发生过似的。

points.title: whatever/no matter 引导的让步
points.explanation: Whatever happens, ... 复现 no matter 让步结构。

examples.en: She kept calm, whatever the neighbours said.
examples.cn: 无论邻居说什么，她都保持冷静。
